title: Test and wording LOWs from the WCLI-140 delta review (none blocking)
description: Follow-ups from the Opus delta review APPROVE at 71bdc7c of ward-cli#267 (WCLI-140). LOW-A: checkout.ts identityBindable has no test pinning writesInto = the ward directory. Add a case with a writable .git and an empty ward directory that is not writable (0o555), expecting inert with no registerHint; add R_OK when writesInto is the ward directory, since bindCheckoutIdentity opens it with O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY; widen the comment on the writable-directory check. The comment hedging on ACLs and EROFS is looser than access() actually behaves; tighten it. LOW-B (runbook step 8): (1) tone: say "To replace it, and only if that checkout should have the project secrets, run ward init from it, then ward profile approve", matching reporting.ts and the DEC-255 (a6) intent, not an imperative; (2) "its checkout reads as unregistered" stops being true once registered; (3) 0.1.1 is framed two ways in step 8; note it where step 5 pins the tag. LOW-C: the unwritable-git test in test/reporting.test.ts should use test.skipIf(process.getuid?.() === 0) so a root run shows as skipped, not passed. LOW-D (record only): the runbook dropped the clause "the replacement matches profile, project and checkout root"; nothing is lost.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each LOW above is corrected, with a test that goes red when the writesInto ward-directory check is removed
lore check and bun run check stay green

implementationNotes: Implemented on fix/WCLI-145-review-lows. LOW-A: identityBindable now requires R_OK as well when writesInto is the existing ward directory (the bind opens it O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY), and its comment is rewritten (access() honours ACLs and read-only mounts; what it cannot see is a race or a refusal only the open raises). Two new reporting tests: a ward directory at 0o555 (not writable) and at 0o300 (not readable), each with a writable .git, expecting inert with no registerHint. Controls run: dropping the writesInto = directory assignment turns both red; dropping R_OK turns only the 0o300 case red. LOW-B: runbook step 8 now reads "To replace it, and only if that checkout should have the project secrets, run ward init from it, then ward profile approve"; "its checkout reads as unregistered" now says "until registered"; the 0.1.1 double framing is resolved inside step 8 by making the release history consistently past tense ("0.1.1 raised it from 2 to 3"), NOT by a note at step 5, because the documentation lore profile sits at its token budget and the step 5 note put it ~23 tokens over (max_tokens not raised). LOW-C: the unwritable-git test and the two new ones use test.skipIf(root). LOW-D recorded only: the runbook dropped the clause "the replacement matches profile, project and checkout root"; nothing is lost. bun run check 1224 pass; lore check, lore validate --strict and check-lore-agent-sources green.
